description: Cross-language contract fixture for the server-owned run and thread origin. The Gateway stamps metadata[key] = {"kind": <one of kinds>, "provider"?: ..., "namespace"?: ...} on runs started by a server-side launcher, and on the thread when it creates one (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/run_origin.py); runs.origin_kind holds the kind. The frontend reads the same key to pick a thread's origin marker. Not to be confused with scheduled_origin_key in scheduled_goal_notes_contract.json, which marks the scheduled prompt message inside a run.
extension_message_description: Message-level marker: additional_kwargs[extension_message_key] = {"namespace": ...} on the input messages of a run an extension started through AgentRuns. Server-stamped from the run's origin; client copies are stripped. The frontend renders such a message as posted by that extension, not typed by the user.
